name: Espresso
description: Coffee forced through fine grounds under pressure — concentrated, not just strong.

tcm.note: Read with coffee; concentration intensifies it.

histamine.note: SIGHI reads espresso as slightly better tolerated than filter coffee, not worse. No DAO effect; the caffeine stimulation is the concern.
histamine.why: Read as coffee. SIGHI puts espresso a point below filter coffee; Taseer does not separate them.

stimulant.note: Same profile as coffee, concentrated into less liquid — the dose arrives sooner rather than being larger.
